inputs.text: Animate THIS EXACT character image, preserving its design and flat 2D cartoon style precisely. The character is a blue bipedal creature with red fin-like cheeks, red eyes, a light cream belly, a tall blue dorsal fin and a tan shell on its back. It plants its feet firmly, raises both arms up in front of its chest and charges a glowing blue Water Orb between its hands, the orb of water swirling and growing larger as the creature concentrates. Do not change the character design, do not add anything, no 3D rendering, no new characters. Locked-off camera, plain solid white background.

3d render, cgi, pixar, photorealistic, realistic, blurry, distorted, deformed, morphing, changing design, extra characters, extra limbs, text, watermark, logo, camera movement, zoom, background change, colored background
